text: Cross-border e-commerce (referred to as "CBE") is an interdisciplinary field that integrates knowledge from various domains such as international trade, e-commerce, foreign languages, international logistics, and legal compliance. It focuses on the commodity transactions, service provision, and related supporting activities carried out through e-commerce platforms between different countries or regions. With the deep integration of globalization and the digital economy, cross-border e-commerce has become one of the core driving forces for the growth of international trade. This field has also attracted much attention due to its strong practicality and high market demand.
